_about: Named sizes for preset.py. Every entry cites the platform's own documentation (checked 2026-09-23) with the sentence that states the size. A platform without a current official size is left out on purpose - X/Twitter's card docs no longer state one. preset.py is only used when the user names a preset; the skill never picks a size on its own.

og.quote: Use images that are at least 1200 x 630 pixels for the best display on high resolution devices.

instagram-square.description: Instagram feed, square (1:1, inside the documented 1.91:1-3:4 range at 1080 wide)
instagram-square.quote: Upload a photo with a width of at least 1080 pixels with an aspect ratio between 1.91:1 and 3:4.

instagram-portrait.quote: we keep that photo at its original resolution as long as the photo's aspect ratio is between 1.91:1 and 3:4.

instagram-landscape.quote: we keep that photo at its original resolution as long as the photo's aspect ratio is between 1.91:1 and 3:4.

instagram-reel-cover.quote: The recommended size for cover photos is 420px by 654px (or 1:1.55 ratio).

instagram-story.description: Instagram Stories 9:16 (from Meta's ads guide; no organic Stories size is documented)

youtube-thumbnail.description: YouTube video thumbnail (16:9; the documented minimum width is 640)
youtube-thumbnail.quote: Have a resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels for videos and 2160 x 3840 for Shorts, with a minimum width of 640 pixels for videos

youtube-shorts-thumbnail.quote: Have a resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels for videos and 2160 x 3840 for Shorts

pinterest-pin.quote: We recommend using a 2:3 aspect ratio, or 1000 x 1500 pixels.

apple-touch-icon.description: apple-touch-icon for iPhone (shown in Apple's markup example)

pwa-icon-192.quote: For Chromium, you must provide at least a 192x192 pixel icon and a 512x512 pixel icon.

pwa-icon-512.quote: For Chromium, you must provide at least a 192x192 pixel icon and a 512x512 pixel icon.
